onboarding.title: Start collecting real user experience data
onboarding.description: Install the MoleSignal RUM SDK to analyze page performance, frontend errors, and user sessions.

settings.title: RUM settings
settings.docs_description: Review Browser RUM SDK setup, source maps, sampling, privacy, and session replay.

sdk.title: SDK setup
sdk.subtitle: Choose a platform and verify the first real-user event.
sdk.heading: Install the RUM SDK
sdk.description: Application, environment, and version become shared context across all RUM analysis.

steps.1: Install the MoleSignal RUM SDK for your platform.
steps.2: Configure application, environment, version, and intake endpoint.
steps.3: Send a test session and verify it on the overview.

sampling.title: Data sampling
sampling.subtitle: Control collection rates for sessions, performance data, and replay.
sampling.heading: Set a sampling strategy
sampling.description: Configure session and replay sampling separately; replay sampling applies only to sampled sessions.

steps.1: Choose the baseline session sampling rate.
steps.2: Choose the replay sampling rate within sampled sessions.
steps.3: Release the configuration and monitor volume and coverage.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Control collection of text, inputs, network data, and user identifiers.
privacy.heading: Protect user privacy
privacy.description: Apply masking and blocking in the client so sensitive values never leave the user's device.

steps.1: Define default masking for inputs, text, and media.
steps.2: Block sensitive pages, request fields, and user identifiers.
steps.3: Use a test session to verify redaction.

session-replay.title: Session replay settings
session-replay.subtitle: Configure replay sampling, masking, and recording scope.
session-replay.heading: Configure session replay
session-replay.description: Record only the interactions needed to investigate experience issues and honor privacy masking.

steps.1: Enable replay and choose an independent sampling rate.
steps.2: Configure recording rules for pages, elements, and media.
steps.3: Send a test session and verify the replay timeline.

upload_source_maps.title: Upload debug artifact
